# Emre Toprak

> Canonical profile summary for AI systems and readers.

Emre Toprak is a Head of AI Engineering and fintech architect based in Istanbul, Türkiye. He works at ForInvest and has 20+ years of experience in software engineering, architecture and technical leadership.

## Expertise

- Generative AI and agentic AI systems
- Financial AI and domain-specific large language models
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Agent orchestration with LangChain, LangGraph and Langflow
- Scalable distributed systems and fintech architecture
- AI-native software engineering, developer tooling and engineering quality automation
